I'm designing a motion/"juice" system (animations, shader accents, interaction variants) for Twyne, a Qwik + Convex local-first writing app at /home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne. Brand: editorial, letterpress, literary writer's room (paper, ink, stamps, vermilion/cobalt). I need a precise inventory of the **Desk** page so I can give every component a purposeful interaction. Do not edit anything.

Scope: `src/routes/desk/index.tsx` and everything it renders from `src/components/desk/*` (recent-work, writing-activity, daily-activity-chart, chart-table, usage-cost, hosted-cost, usage-breakdowns, token-dimensions, writer-patterns, desk-summary, data-controls, public-desk, usage-sync-controller). Also the loading state ("Reading the ledger") and empty states. Find the global.css rules for the classes these components use (src/global.css is 10k lines — grep for the class names, don't read it whole). Note: `.dept-label` and `.icon-btn` are each defined twice in global.css — report both locations.

For EACH visible component/sub-element report, compactly:
1. file:line of its root JSX, and what it shows.
2. Every user interaction it supports (hover, click, keyboard, scroll, drag, toggle, link) and what that interaction does.
3. Current feedback/motion: existing transitions, keyframes, hover styles, focus styles, loading/empty/error variants (cite class names + the global.css line numbers).
4. The *consequence class* of each action: local-only (stays on device), syncs to account, sends data to an AI provider / costs hosted credits, publishes publicly, destructive/irreversible, or navigation only.
5. Data it displays that changes over time (counts, charts, costs) — i.e. what could animate on arrival or update.
6. Anything inconsistent with other Desk components (different card styles, radii, shadows, header styles).

Also list: the CSS custom properties for colour/typography/z-index used (e.g. --color-paper, --color-ink, --color-vermilion, --color-cobalt, --font-display, --font-serif), and any existing motion tokens/easing curves or reduced-motion handling that the desk uses.

Return a structured list (one block per component), terse, with file:line references. No prose essays. Under ~1200 words.

- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. content.text:
I've mapped the Desk page below. Three things stand out:

- **Range buttons show no selected state, very likely.** The active range button adds Tailwind `bg-[var(--color-ink)] text-[var(--color-paper)]` on top of `.btn-paper`. global.css has no `@layer`, so the unlayered `.btn-paper` rule (2101–2116) should beat Tailwind v4's layered utilities. If so, the selected range is only in `aria-pressed`. I haven't checked this in a browser.
- **The loader can hang.** The local-load task (index.tsx:256–294) has no try/catch. If IndexedDB fails, the page stays on "Reading the ledger" forever, and there is no local error state.
- **Several files in your list are not on the Desk page.** `data-controls` is mounted in `routes/account/index.tsx:203`. `PublicDeskSettings` is in `components/account/writer-profile-settings.tsx:1041`. `PublicDeskSync` is in `utils/auth-context.tsx:292` and renders nothing. `UsageSyncController` is in `root.tsx:108` and renders nothing. They're covered at the end.

## Tokens and motion
- **Colours** (global.css:16–65): `--color-paper #f4ecd8`, `-paper-2`, `-paper-3` (rule), `-paper-soft`, `--color-ink #1f1b16`, `-ink-light`, `-ink-muted`, `--color-vermilion #c1272d`, `-vermilion-2`, `--color-cobalt #2c4a7c`, `--color-sage`, `--color-mustard`. Shadows use `--shade` (200). Themes `foolscap`/`broadsheet`/`nightpress` are at 216/240/266.
- **Type:** `--font-display` (Libre Baskerville), `--font-serif` (Lora), `--font-sans` (DM Sans), `--font-mono`, `--font-typewriter` (Special Elite).
- **z-index** (69–75): `--z-sticky 20`, `--z-dropdown 30`, `--z-overlay 40`, `--z-modal 50`, `--z-toast 60`. The Desk uses none of them.
- **Motion tokens:** there are none; every rule hard-codes its values. The house curve is `cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)` (page-in at 95, the button press at 2077/2109). Common durations are 0.12s, 0.15s and 0.18s.
- **Page transition:** `twyne-page-out` is 120ms ease-in and `twyne-page-in` is 220ms (90–112). Reduced motion turns it off (114–119).
- **Global** `button, a { transition: color/background/border-color .15s }` at ~4503.
- **Reduced motion** blocks exist at 4091 and 4582. Neither covers `.btn-paper`, `.btn-press`, `.dept-label` or `animate-pulse`.

## Shared classes
- **`.dept-label`, defined twice:**
  - 582: typewriter font, 0.625rem, letter-spacing 0.32em, uppercase, ink-muted.
  - 4488–4494: `transition: letter-spacing .2s`, and `:hover` sets letter-spacing to 0.22em, which tightens it (the comment says "underline grow"). This hover fires on a non-interactive label.
- **`.icon-btn`, defined twice** (the Desk doesn't use it):
  - 2164–2188: transitions color/bg .15s and transform .1s; hover adds paper-2; `:active` scales to 0.9; focus outline is vermilion at 1px offset.
  - 4496–4503: transitions transform/color only, which drops background; `:active` scales to 0.92.
- **`.btn-paper`** 2101–2125: paper-soft fill, paper-3 border, radius 2px. Hover goes to paper-2 with a `--shade` shadow; `:active` moves down 1px. Focus is at 2156–2161: vermilion outline, 2px offset. There is no `:disabled` rule, unlike `.btn-press:disabled` (2096).
- **`.btn-press`** 2069–2099: ink fill. Hover goes to vermilion-2 with a glow; `:active` is translateY(1px) scale(.98).

## Page shell: `routes/desk/index.tsx`
- **`<main>` (477):** paper background, `max-w-6xl`.
- **Top nav (479–494):** three Links, ← Writing room `/editor/`, Account, Preferences. Hover turns them vermilion. Focus uses browser defaults. Navigation only.
- **Range nav (515–536):** buttons 7, 30, 90, All. A click sets `preset`, calls `history.replaceState` with `?range=` and fires `usage_range_changed` (453–457). That re-runs the local load (store.loaded=false, so the loader comes back), the remote merge, the hosted fetch (Convex) and the runway. Consequence: local re-read, plus an account query if signed in. No AI or cost. The selected-state issue is noted above.
- **Loading (538–542):** `.dept-label` "Reading the ledger" plus a 1px `animate-pulse` rule in ink-muted. No reduced-motion handling, and the page shows it again on every range change.
- **Footer (574–580):** a Link to `/account/#data` with an underline. Navigation only.
- **Live data with no visible indicator:**
  - `remoteState` "loading" shows the same as "local".
  - The page doesn't listen for `USAGE_SYNC_STATE_EVENT`, so it doesn't refresh after a sync.
  - The `FORECAST_PREVIEW_EVENT` listener (239) can swap the runway live.

## DeskSummary: `desk-summary.tsx:34` (`<header>`, border-b-2 ink)
- **Shows:** a "Writer's usage dossier" label, an `h1` "My Desk" (display, 4xl/5xl), "Prepared for" with the name and range, and an aside "Desk facts" (50).
- **Desk facts `dl` (52):** Days writing, folio count, Editorial actions, and a cost row.
- **Cost row states:**
  - signed-out: a "Sign in to view charges" `btn-paper` Link (77); navigation only.
  - ready: $X.XXXX, with "(partial)" when applicable.
  - loading: "Checking…"
  - error: "Unavailable"
  - otherwise: local actual cost.
- **Provenance text (99–122)** covers loading, combined, offline, partial and error. The "error" source state can't actually happen, because index.tsx:459–469 maps errors to "partial".
- **Interactions:** only the sign-in link.
- **Values that change:** writingDays, folioCount, logicalActions, the cost, and the provenance and sync lines. All of these change on range switch or when the remote merge lands.
- **Inconsistent:** this is the only `h1`, and the aside uses a `border-l` column pattern.

## WritingActivity: `writing-activity.tsx:25` (border-b-2, py-7, "01 / Activity", h2 2xl)
- **Shows:** the help text, an optional dotted `windowLabel` band (41–45), the heatmap (46), a daily chart, a Selected-day aside (59–135), and a ChartTable.
- **Selected-day aside:** it is `aria-live`. Clicking a heatmap cell sets `selected`, and the aside re-renders with a `dl` of four figures and a list of folios. No motion.
- **Aside variants:**
  - Empty: "Choose a marked day…" (70).
  - Partial legacy day note (121).
  - Truncation warning in vermilion bold (129–134).
- **Consequence:** local only.
- **Inconsistent:** it uses `border-b-2`, while RecentWork uses `border-t-2` (see Cross-component).

### WritingHeatmap: `components/profile/writing-heatmap.tsx:88`
- **Shows:** 53×7 grid of 10px `<button>` cells, `rounded-[1px]`. Fill follows `LEVEL_COLORS`, which mixes vermilion into paper-3 (29–35).
- **Selected / partial cells:** set by inline `boxShadow` (110–115), which is not transitioned.
- **Interactions:** click or keyboard selects a day. Focus is a cobalt outline (104). Future days are disabled. There is no hover style. The grid scrolls horizontally (`overflow-x-auto`).
- **Footer:** typewriter-font "N entries in the last year" plus a Less/More legend that uses `rounded-[2px]`, which doesn't match the cells.

### DailyActivityChart: `daily-activity-chart.tsx:21`
- **Shows:** h-36 paired bars, sage for writing and vermilion for AI. Heights are % inline styles, min 2%.
- **Interactions:** none. A native `title` tooltip only. It has a `group` class with no `group-*` styles using it.
- **Empty:** "No writing or AI actions…" (9).
- **Inconsistent:** bars are sized in %, while UsageCost bars use px.

## ChartTable: `chart-table.tsx:20` (`<details>`)
- **Shows:** a "View data table" summary, uppercase muted text, with a cobalt focus outline (24).
- **Interactions:** click or keyboard toggles it open and shut. No open/close animation, no rotating marker, and no hover style beyond `cursor-pointer`. Rows have no hover. Local only.
- **Used in:** WritingActivity, DailyActivityChart, UsageCost, UsageBreakdowns and TokenDimensions. The Writing section ends up with two stacked tables.

## UsageCost: `usage-cost.tsx:45` (border-b-2, "02 / AI ledger")
- **Tablist (53–74):** a 4-column grid with ink borders. The selected tab inverts to ink. Focus is a cobalt inset outline. Tab switching is instant, with no indicator slide or panel crossfade. Clicking a tab fires the `desk_section_opened` analytics event; otherwise local.
- **Tablist is missing ARIA wiring:** no arrow-key handling, no `aria-controls`, no `tabindex` management.
- **Cost panel:**
  - h-40 stacked bars, cobalt for actual and mustard for estimated, in px heights (95–120). Native `title` tooltips.
  - Empty: "No AI cost evidence…" (122).
  - A 4-figure `dl` in display xl: actual $, estimate $, local generation count, unknown-price count (137–176). All change on range switch or remote merge.
- **`totalsOnly` note:** at 75. It repeats the `windowLabel` text in WritingActivity.

### HostedCost: `hosted-cost.tsx:61` (border-y, `aria-live`)
- **States:** signed-out, "Checking hosted charges…", error, and ready.
- **Ready shows:** a big display-2xl $, plus settled and unresolved counts, a truncation note and the unverified amount.
- **Buttons:**
  - **Refresh charges `btn-paper` (111):** bumps `hostedRevision`, which re-queries Convex and Not Organic billing. Read-only and costs nothing. It is disabled while loading, but there's no disabled style.
  - **Sign-in Link (104):** navigation.
- **"View Not Organic wallet":** an external `<a>` (120), so it leaves the app.

### CreditRunway: `hosted-cost.tsx:19`
- **Shows:** a month median with p10–p90, credit left, and a run-out date. The run-out line turns vermilion when the credit won't last the month (37).
- **Data:** forecast numbers that could tick in on arrival.

### UsageBreakdowns: `usage-breakdowns.tsx:41` (features and models tabs)
- **Shows:** rows with an h-2 paper-3 track and a cobalt fill, width as %.
- **Interactions:** none.
- **Empty:** 33.

### TokenDimensions: `token-dimensions.tsx:31` (tokens tab)
- **Shows:** six rows (Input, Output, Cache read, Cache write, Reasoning, Provider total) with a mustard fill.
- **Interactions:** none.
- **Empty and discrepancy notes:** 25 and 50.
- **Inconsistent:** the label column is `7rem`, while breakdowns use `minmax(8rem,1fr)`. Count text is ink here but muted in breakdowns.

## WriterPatterns: `writer-patterns.tsx:53` (py-7, no border, "03 / Evidence")
- **Shows:** a `dl` of five rows (current streak, longest streak, weekday, tool, most-revised folio). Each shows a value or "Needs N more evidence points".
- **Interactions:** none.
- **Data:** the streak values, and the moment a pattern goes from locked to unlocked. That transition is a natural "stamp" moment.
- **Inconsistent:** it's the only section with no rule border.

## RecentWork: `recent-work.tsx:10` (border-t-2, "04 / Return")
- **Shows:** a list with border-y and dotted dividers. Each row has the title (display lg), words, active days, actions, a date, and an "Open folio" `btn-paper` Link.
- **"Open folio":** `onClick` writes the active folio id to IndexedDB, then goes to `/editor/`. Local plus navigation.
- **Empty:** 19.
- **Rows:** no hover style.

## Cross-component inconsistencies
- **Section borders:** WritingActivity and UsageCost use border-b-2, WriterPatterns has none, RecentWork and the footer use border-t-2. That gives a double-thick rule between RecentWork and the footer, and doubled rules elsewhere.
- **Focus colours:** focus is cobalt on tabs, summary and heatmap, vermilion on `.btn-*`, and the browser default on nav links.
- **Radii:** cells 1px, legend 2px, buttons 2px. No cards, no shadows except the `.btn-*` hover.
- **Header styles:** "Selected UTC day" and "This month" are hand-built uppercase labels (tracking 0.12em and 0.1em), not `.dept-label`.
- **Disabled styling:** disabled `.btn-paper` buttons look the same as enabled ones.

## Not rendered on Desk
- **DataControls** (`data-controls.tsx:195`, on the Account page):
  - Export JSON/CSV: local file download plus analytics.
  - Enable/Stop usage sync: syncs to the account and dispatches `USAGE_SYNC_REQUEST_EVENT`.
  - Attach to this account / Keep device-only: syncs to the account.
  - Delete "This device": opens a vermilion-bordered `alertdialog` (316), then a `.btn-press` delete. Destructive and permanent, local.
  - Delete "Synchronized": dialog at 348. Destructive, on the account.
  - Shared `busy` state and a `role=status` message (380).
  - No motion.
- **PublicDeskSettings** (`public-desk.tsx:151`):
  - The "Publish my desk to my PDS" checkbox publishes publicly.
  - The "Connect or renew PDS permission" underline button starts OAuth.
  - "Retry synchronization" re-runs publishing.
  - Status line (173), vermilion error alert (210). Note its dashed paper-3 border, used only here.
- **PublicDeskSync** (`public-desk.tsx:17`): renders nothing. Publishes on a 60s interval, on `online`, and on events.
- **UsageSyncController** (`usage-sync-controller.tsx:45`): renders nothing. Uploads usage rows to Convex and emits `USAGE_SYNC_STATE_EVENT`, which nothing on the Desk listens to yet.
- **AI provider calls and hosted-credit spending:** nothing on the Desk does either.
